name: Genshin Impact Quest
title: Genshin Impact Quest
body:
What this article covers: 

  • Promotion Terms
  • How to Complete the Quest
  • Redemption Instructions
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Promotion Terms

Quest Game: Genshin Impact
Quest Name: V4.6 Quest

Offer Details: Stream 15 minutes of Genshin Impact to receive a V4.6 Bundle packed with valuable items! This bundle includes the following items: 

  • Mora ×20,000
  • Sanctifying Unction ×4
  • Mystic Enhancement Ore ×5
  • Hero's Wit ×3

The first 300k users will also receive Primogems x30. 

Who is Eligible: Available on all platforms and regions where Genshin Impact is available. 

Discord’s premium services are restricted in some regions. If you are unable to access the Gift Inventory, you are not eligible for this Quest or reward.

Availability Period: The V4.6 Quest can be accepted on Discord from April 24th, 2024 until May 7, 2024 (11:59pm UTC). Quest requirements must be completed during this period to receive the reward. Reward gift codes expire May 22, 2024 (4:00pm UTC).

Other Terms: Limit of one reward redemption per account.

For more information on Discord Quests and to view the currently active quests, visit our Discord Quest Help Center. 

How to Complete the Quest

Once you have accepted the Quest, you must stream the game through the Discord desktop app and have at least one friend actively watching the stream to complete the Quest requirement. 

In order to successfully complete the V4.6 Quest, players who meet the eligibility criteria must live stream their Genshin Impact gameplay to a friend via a Discord voice channel for a minimum duration of 15 minutes on the desktop app. 

1. Before you can begin the Quest, launch the game.

2. Then, head to your Discord desktop app and navigate to a direct message (DM), group chat, or a  server of your choice.

3. Once there, start a voice call or join a voice channel and select the Screen Share [] icon located in the voice status panel. Be sure to select the individual application for the game before you Go Live. 

NOTE: You must select the game application to stream! Streaming your device’s screen will not progress your Quest forward. Once you stream, you can check the progress bar on the Gift inventory to ensure progress is being made on the Quest.  

4. When you’re ready to stream your gameplay, press Go Live. You can learn more about streaming your game here. 

Redemption Instructions

1. Once you have completed the Quest by streaming 15 minutes of Genshin Impact using Go Live on Discord, you will receive a Gift Code in your Discord Gift Inventory. You can learn more about Go Live and screen sharing here.

2. Then, visit the official Genshin Impact website's code redemption page and log in to your game account. 

3. While there, enter the redemption code and you'll receive the bundle via in-game mail.  

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is there a limit on how many Quests I can redeem on my Discord account?

A: Eligible users can redeem one of each of the available Quest campaigns on their Discord account. 

For more information on Discord Quests and to view the currently active quests, visit our Discord Quest Help Center.

Q: Is this feature/promotion available in my region?

A: Some Quests will not be available in all regions based on terms and conditions. If you are in an ineligible region for a Quest, you will not be able to complete it.
Additionally, Discord’s premium services are restricted in some regions. If you are unable to access the Gift Inventory, you are not eligible for Quests.

Q: Why am I unable to see Quests on the Discord mobile app?

A: This feature is only available on the desktop and browser app.

Q: I have concerns or questions regarding privacy and Quests. 

A: ​​We encourage you to review Discord’s Privacy Policy for further details about how we use your information. You can head over to our Data Used for In-Game Rewards article, to learn more about how we use data for Quests. 

Q: Why am I unable to complete Quest while using Linux?

A: Currently, Quest rewards are unable to be earned on Linux devices. 

However, our team is looking into a resolution for this issue so that earning Quest rewards is possible on Linux in the future. For now, we recommend completing the requirement on a different operating system, like Windows or MacOS. 

Our support team does not have an exact ETA for when a solution will be available, and won't be able to provide any status updates on this specific issue.

Q: I no longer see a Quest. Where did it go?

A: Quests are typically only available for a limited amount of time. If you no longer see a Quest in the Gift Inventory or in-app notifications about the quest, the period to complete and claim the reward for the Quest is over.

name: Recently Played Games on Profiles
title: Recently Played Games on Profiles
body:
What this article covers: 

  • What is Recently Played Games?
  • How to Manage your Recently Played Games Settings
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What is Recently Played Games?

This feature is currently an experiment and limited to a small percentage of users. 

Recently Played Games will display a maximum of 3 tiles on a user’s profile showcasing the recent games that they played. The game, how long ago it was last played, and how much time has been spent playing the game will be displayed in these tiles.

How to Manage your Recently Played Games Settings

If a detectable game you recently played is not showing, here is how to enable it. 

Option 1

1. Tap on the cogwheel [] to enter your User Settings.

2. Select Connections. If the game you are playing is a verified game, the game should be available for you to add as a connection.

Option 2

1. Tap on the cogwheel [] to enter your User Settings.

2. Then head to Registered Games.

3. If you don’t  see your game here, tap on Add it to add the game (make sure your game is open when trying to add it).

4. If you want to prevent future sharing of a game, tap on the eye icon to disable detection.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How can I disable Recently Played Games from displaying on my profile?

A: Tap on the cogwheel [] to enter your User Settings, then head to Profiles. You should see the option to toggle this feature. A checkmark [] means it’s enabled and an [] means it’s disabled.

Q: How far back/how long can a game activity be displayed on my profile?

A: A game activity will be displayed on your profile for 1 month.

Q: Are Activities also captured in the recently played?

A: Activities will not be displayed.

Q: How many games can be displayed at a time?

A: Only 4 games can be displayed.

Q: Who can see Recent Games on my profile?

Recent Games will be visible to another user if you are friends, if you are suggested friends, if you’ve sent a friend request, or if you share at least one server where you have not disabled Activity Display.

Q: Will disabling Activity Display in a specific server prevent Recent Played Games from appearing on my profile?

Yes. However, if you enable it again at any point, your Recent Played Games (including anything that was played when it was turned off) will then be displayed in your profile.

name: Spring 2024 Nitro Promotion
title: Spring 2024 Nitro Promotion
body:
Please make sure your Discord app is updated to the latest version!

Spring into style with our new Nitro promotion starting on April 24, 2024 (10:00AM PT)! Read below to learn more.

Promotion Summary

Offer Details: Get a Gyoiko Sakura avatar decoration when you sign up for a Nitro membership (Nitro Monthly or Nitro Yearly) on the desktop or browser client of Discord. The Gyoiko Sakura avatar decoration will be available for use as long as your Nitro membership is active. You can learn more about avatar decorations here. 

  • Promotion also applies to upgrades from Nitro Basic and Nitro Classic to Nitro.
  • Note: Nitro Basic and mobile (Apple/Google Play) membership purchases are not eligible for this promotion.

Who is Eligible: 

  • First time Nitro Monthly members and first time Nitro Yearly members are eligible as well as previous Nitro members who have not been members in the 7 days prior to the attempted promotion claim date.
  • Active members on the Nitro Basic and Nitro Classic plans.

Requirements: This promotion is only available for purchases on our desktop and browser clients, and is not available in all regions. 

Deadline for Claiming Promo: This promotion must be claimed after the promo begins on April 24, 2024 (10:00AM PT) and before May 1, 2024 (10:00AM PT).

What this article covers: 

  • What is Discord Nitro?
  • Eligibility for Claiming the Spring 2024 Nitro Promo 
  • How do I claim my Gyoiko Sakura Avatar Decoration?
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What is Discord Nitro?

Discord Nitro is our subscription plan that gives you access to special perks that’ll make your time on Discord as fun as ever! Personalize and enhance your experience with popular perks like HD streaming, 500MB file uploads, profile and avatar customizations, and more:

  • Custom Profiles
  • Discord App Color Themes
  • Custom App Icons
  • Custom Emojis
  • 2 Server Boost
  • More Nitro & Nitro Basic perks

Eligibility for Claiming the Spring Nitro Promo

Wondering whether you’ll be able to claim this promotion? As long as you meet the criteria  below, you should see the promotion in your Nitro tab!

Note: After refreshing your client - if you do not see the promotion within your Nitro tab - this means that you are not eligible for this promotion.

This promotion is currently available for:

  • First time Nitro Monthly or Nitro Yearly members.
  • Users who have had a Nitro membership in the past, but not within the last 7 days.
  • Active Nitro Basic and Classic members who upgrade to Nitro.
  • You can only access this promotion through the Discord desktop or browser app.

Unfortunately, this promotion won’t be available for:

  • Current Nitro members.
  • Users who had an active Nitro membership, including free trials, within the past 7 days prior to the date they attempt to claim this promotion.
  • Purchases made through the Discord mobile app (iOS and Android).

This promotion is only available in certain regions. 

How do I claim my Gyoiko Sakura Avatar Decoration?

Step 1: Go to the Nitro tab

On the desktop or browser app, press the Direct Messages button in the top left corner and then select the Nitro tab. Alternatively, you can navigate to your User Settings > Nitro.

Note: You cannot claim this promotion through the mobile (iOS and Android) apps. If you are eligible and would like to receive this promotion, please log into your account through the Discord desktop or browser app.

Step 2: Subscribe to Nitro Monthly or Yearly

Once you are at the Nitro page - simply select Join Nitro or Upgrade and select either the monthly or yearly plan for Nitro.

On the next screen, enter your credit card information and other payment details.

Step 3: Receive Your Gyoiko Sakura Avatar Decoration

Upon successful completion of the payment, your account will be upgraded to Nitro!

Your Gyoiko Sakura avatar decoration will automatically be available in your inventory.

If you meet the eligibility requirements and didn’t receive your Gyoiko Avatar Decoration when signing up for Nitro by May 1, 2024 (10:00AM PST), please reach out to our Support Team for further assistance.

Step 4: How to Apply Your Avatar Decoration

1. Once you have claimed the Gyoiko Sakura Avatar Decoration, you can head over to your User Settings by pressing the cogwheel [] icon in the bottom left corner. 

2. Then, select Profiles > Change Decoration where you will find all of your decorations. 

3. While in the Change Decoration window, select your Gyoiko Sakura avatar decoration and press Apply. 

4. Be sure to confirm your changes by pressing Save Changes and you should be all set!

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: I don't see the promotion details on my Nitro tab. Why?

A: If you don't see any promotion details on your Nitro tab on the desktop or browser (this promotion is not available on the mobile clients), it is because you do not meet the eligibility criteria.

Q: I’m a current Nitro member. Am I eligible to get the Gyoiko Sakura avatar decoration?

A: If you are a Nitro member prior to the start of this promotion, excluding Basic and Classic members, you are not eligible to receive the Gyoiko Sakura avatar decoration at this time. We are cooking up more exciting things for current Nitro members - so stay tuned! In the meantime, you can check out all of the current Nitro benefits, including discounts and Nitro exclusive items in the Shop, here.

Q: Where can I find my new avatar decoration and how do I apply it?

A: You can head over to your User Settings > Profiles > Change Decoration to find your claimed avatar decoration. While in the Change Decoration window, select the avatar decoration you would like to use and select Apply > Save Changes.  

You can learn more about avatar decorations here. 

Q: What happens if I don't receive my Gyoiko Avatar Decoration?
A: If you meet the eligibility requirements and didn’t receive your Gyoiko Avatar Decoration when signing up for Nitro by May 1, 2024 (10:00AM PST), please reach out to our Support Team for further assistance.

Q: Do I need Nitro to use the Gyoiko Sakura avatar decoration?

A: Yes, you will need an active Nitro membership to use this avatar decoration as it’s considered Nitro Exclusive.

Q: If I upgrade my subscription from Nitro Basic or Nitro Classic to Nitro, can I receive this promotion?

A: Yes, this promotion applies for upgrades from Nitro Basic or Classic to Nitro.

Q: How much will I be charged if I upgrade my plan to Nitro?

A: The amount you'll be charged for upgrading to Nitro depends on:
1. Whether you're upgrading from Basic or Classic
2. The amount of your existing membership plan you haven’t used
3. The remaining amount of your new membership plan you will use after upgrading

For example, if you've used Nitro Basic for only 10 days this month, you'll only be charged for those 10 days at Basic's price. Then, if you upgrade to Nitro mid-month and have 20 days left, you'll only pay for those 20 days at Nitro's price, rather than for the entire month. You can find more details about this payment breakdown here.

Q: I claimed and redeemed a different free trial for Discord Nitro already. Can I access this promo?

A: Unfortunately, if you are currently on a free trial or have been in the last 7 days before attempting to claim, you are not eligible for this promotion. Have no fear, there will be more of these down the road! 

Q: If I have Nitro credit in my account, can I apply it to this promo?

A: If you have credit in your account from a previous Nitro membership, this credit will be automatically applied to the purchase total when you check out.

If you have credit in your account that is associated with a different Nitro membership type (ex: Nitro Classic), it will not apply to this promotion.

Q: I see a notification saying "You're ineligible for this offer". Why?

A: If you encounter this notification, it is because you do not meet the eligibility criteria outlined above.

Q: I purchased a Nitro membership during the promotion period, but I’d like to request a refund. What are the steps?

A: Before requesting a refund, please review our Refund Policy to ensure that your purchase is eligible for a refund.

If you’d like to proceed, please send in a ticket specifying that you’d like a refund for your Nitro purchase to our support team here: dis.gd/billing and our agents will be happy to assist you.

Please note that if your refund is issued, you will lose any promotional value or discounts associated with the purchase.

body:

What are Discord Quests? 

Quests are a way for players to discover games and earn rewards for streaming them on Discord.

How do I complete a Discord Quest?

Here are the steps to complete a Discord Quest: 

1. Accept the Quest 

2. Stream the game to friends on Discord

3. Claim your reward 

Please see below for more detailed information on how to complete each step. 

Accept the Quest 

Quests can only be accepted through the Discord desktop and browser apps.

You may see an alert in your Discord app about a Discord Quest. Hover over the Quest bar and select it to expand and learn more about the Quest. If you want to participate, you can press Accept Quest. 

If you don't see the Quest bar, navigate to your User Settings > Gift Inventory.

While there, you will see the active Discord Quests that are available to join. Press Accept Quest to join the quest.

Stream the Game to Friends on Discord 

To complete a Quest requirement, you must stream the game through the Discord desktop app and have at least one friend actively watching the stream. 

Each Quest will have its own required time to stream and you can confirm how long you need to stream the game for in the Promotion Terms. 

1. Before you can begin the Quest, launch the game .

2. Then, head to your Discord desktop app and navigate to a direct message (DM), group chat, or a server of your choice.

3. Once there, start a voice call or join a voice channel and select the Screen Share [] icon located in the voice status panel or within the voice call. Be sure to select the individual application for the game before you Go Live. 

NOTE: You must select the game application to stream! Streaming your device’s screen will not progress your Quest forward. Once you stream, you can check the progress bar on the Gift inventory to ensure progress is being made on the Quest.  

4. When you’re ready to stream your gameplay, press Go Live. You can learn more about streaming your game here. 

Claim Your Reward 

Once you have completed the Quest, you can claim the reward by pressing the Claim Reward button within any Discord Quest in-app notification.

The easiest way to claim your reward is by heading over to your User Settings > Gift Inventory. 

When you claim an in-game item reward, you will be given a Discord Quest redemption code that you will need to redeem on the partnered game redemption website. You can find a link by heading over to our Active Discord Quests section! You will also receive an email with redemption instructions once you’ve completed the Quest.

When you claim Discord rewards, once you finish the Quest you can claim your reward by selecting the Claim Reward button. You can learn more about adding / removing your Discord avatar decoration or profile effect here.

Opting-out of Quests Promotions

If you’re not interested in receiving promotions of Discord Quests, you can control these promotions in the following ways: 

Hide an In-app Promotion of an Individual Quest 

If you still want to receive in-app promotions for future Quests, but you want to hide an in-app promotion for a specific Quest or game you’re not interested in, press the ellipsis [] on the Quest in-app promotion to access the menu and then select Hide This to hide this particular in-app promotion. 

Once you've done this, you'll no longer receive notifications about this Quest in that particular in-app promotion style. 

If you encounter a different in-app promotion for that same Quest (for example, you may also see the Quest in the Active Now section of the Discord app) you can hide those by following the steps mentioned above. 

If you hide all the in-app promotions of a specific Quest, you can still view and accept the Quest in your Gift Inventory. 

Opt-out of personalized promotion for all Quests 

If you do not want to receive personalized promotions for any Quests based on your activity or data you share with Discord, you can disable your In-game rewards (aka Quests) settings within your Privacy & Safety settings. 

1. Press the cogwheel [] in the bottom left corner of your Discord desktop/browser app to navigate to your User Settings.

2. Then select the Privacy & Safety tab in the left hand panel and scroll down to the How We Use Your Data section.

3. Disable the In-game rewards (aka Quests) setting by selecting the toggle. You can learn more about how data is used for in-game rewards here. 

Although these settings are disabled, you will still be able to participate in Quests if you navigate to your Gift Inventory. You may see Quests shared by your friends or reflected in their activity status on Discord.  

If you decide later that you want to receive notifications about Discord Quests based on your activity, you will need to make sure to enable the In-game rewards (aka Quests) setting in Privacy & Safety. You can learn more about these settings by visiting Data Privacy Controls or reading our Privacy Policy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is there a limit on how many Quests I can redeem on my Discord account?

A: Eligible users can redeem one of each of the available Quest campaigns on their Discord account. 

Q: Is this feature/promotion available in my region?

A: Quests will not be available in certain regions. If you are in an ineligible region for a Quest, you will not be able to complete it.

Additionally, Discord’s premium services are restricted in some regions. If you are unable to access the Gift Inventory, you are not eligible for Quests.

A: This feature is only available on the desktop and browser app.

A: ​​We encourage you to review Discord’s Privacy Policy for further details about how we use your information. You can head over to our Data Used for In-Game Rewards article, to learn more about how we use data for Quests. 

Q: Why am I unable to complete Quest while using Linux?

A: Currently, Quest rewards are unable to be earned on Linux devices. 

However, our team is looking into a resolution for this issue so that earning Quest rewards is possible on Linux in the future. For now, we recommend completing the requirement on a different operating system, like Windows or MacOS. 

Our support team does not have an exact ETA for when a solution will be available, and won't be able to provide any status updates on this specific issue.

Q: I no longer see a Quest. Where did it go?

A: Quests are typically only available for a limited amount of time. If you no longer see a Quest in the Gift Inventory or in-app notifications about the quest, the period to complete and claim the reward for the Quest is over.

name: Data Used for In-Game Rewards
title: Data Used for In-Game Rewards
body:
Discord In-Game Rewards are typically rewards or other experiences based on you interacting with the games you love while using Discord. You can view what Quests or other experiences are available on Discord through your Gift Inventory. 

We may tell you about Quests that we think will interest you based on the games you play or other information associated with your Discord account. If you’re not interested in receiving Discord Quests promotions, you can opt-out of this feature in your User Settings.

1. Open Discord and press the cogwheel [] in the bottom left corner to go to User Settings.

2. Then, select the Privacy & Safety tab within the left-hand panel.

3. Scroll down the page to the How We Use Your Data section and make sure to disable the In-game rewards (aka Quests) setting by selecting the toggle. 

4. If you decide later you want to be notified about Quest opportunities, you can enable this setting once again.

name: Polls FAQ
title: Polls FAQ
body:
What this article covers: 

  • What is Polls?
  • How do I create a Poll?
    • Desktop
    • Mobile
  • How do I vote in a Poll?
    • Desktop
    • Mobile
  • How to manage Poll Permissions as a Server Owner/Administrator
    • Role Permission
    • Channel Permission
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What is Polls?

Polls is a feature on Discord with which you can create a poll to have your friends and community members vote on anything! You can add up to 10 answers for people to vote on in each poll. This can help decide the next game you’ll play together for game night, if pineapple belongs on pizza, and so much more!

How do I create a Poll?

A poll can have up to 10 answers listed.

Any text within a poll (including questions and answers), will apply filters set by AutoMod.

Desktop

1. Tap on the plus sign [] located in the text field of the text channel, text chat of a voice channel, or group message that you want to share the poll in.

2. Next, tap Poll to create a new poll.

3. You can input the following information for your poll:

  • What the actual poll is about
  • All possible selectable answers users can vote on (you can also select an emoji or custom emoji to represent each one too)
  • How long the poll will available (1 hour, 4 hours, 8 hours, 24 hours, 3 days, or 1 week)
  • If those voting can select more than one answer

4. Once everything has been filled out, you can tap Post to send your poll!

Mobile

For the best experience with Polls on mobile, please make sure you’re running Discord app version 221 or higher.

1. Tap on the plus sign [] located in the text field of the text channel, text chat of a voice channel, or group message that you want to share the poll in.

2. Next, tap Poll to create a poll.

3. You can input the following information for your poll:

  • What the actual poll is about
  • All possible selectable answers users can vote on (you can also select an emoji or custom emoji to represent each one too)
  • How long the poll will be available (1 hour, 4 hours, 8 hours, 24 hours, 3 days, or 1 week)
  • If those voting can select more than one answer

4. Once everything has been filled out, you can tap on Post to send your poll!

How do I vote in a Poll?

Want to change your selection on a poll? Tap on Remove Vote to remove your vote and then you can vote again.

Desktop

1. Navigate to the poll you want to vote in and then tap on one answer or multiple answers to the poll. Once selected, you’ll see a check mark appear on the right hand side of the poll selection.

2. Tap Vote to submit your answer.

3. You know your vote has gone through once a check mark appears on the selection, and you’ll see the option to change your vote. 

Mobile

1. Navigate to the poll you want to vote on and tap on your vote.

2. Next, tap on Vote to submit your answer.

3. You’ll know your vote has gone through because you’ll see a check mark next to your vote.

How to manage Poll Permissions as a Server Owner/Administrator

Permissions for Polls can be managed from a server or channel level.

Role Permission

1. Tap on your server’s name in the top left corner and then tap on Server Settings.

2. Navigate to Roles and then select which role you’d like to change the permission for, or tap on Default Permissions to edit this role for everyone.

3. Scroll down until you see Create Polls. A “check mark” means this feature is enabled and an “x” means it’s disabled.  

4. Lastly, save your changes to apply them.

Channel Permission

1. Navigate to the channel you want to edit and tap on the cogwheel [].

2. Then, tap on Permissions. 

3. Under this setting you can enable or disable Polls per role. To do so, tap on the role you want to edit.

4. Now scroll down until you see Create Polls. A “check mark” means this feature is enabled and an “x” means it’s disabled.  

5. Lastly, save your changes to apply them.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Where can I start a poll? 

A: A poll can take place in a text channel, direct message, group message, or announcement channel.  

Q: How can I delete a poll?

A: The only way to delete a poll is to delete the entire message (by tapping on the “...” next to a message). Once the poll has been deleted, it can not be restored.

Q: Can I vote anonymously in a poll? 

A: No, there is no option to vote anonymously at this time. 

Q: How long can a poll be open for?

A: The poll creator chooses how long they want the poll to be open when creating the poll. The poll creator can choose to end the poll early at any time. Unless it ends early, a poll can be left open for up to 1 week.

Q: Can I use slash commands (for example: /poll) to create a poll?

A: No, it is not possible to create a poll using a slash command at this time.

Q: Can poll choices be modified at any time?

A: As long as the poll is still open, you can modify your poll choice. 

Q: Can poll results be saved and/or deleted?

A: While polls behave like messages in terms of being deleted, there is no separate function to archive polls at this time. You can pin a poll to Pinned Messages.

name: Members List Recent Activity FAQ
title: Members List Recent Activity FAQ
body:
To learn more about activity status, check out the Activity Status (Recent Activity) article.

What this article covers: 

  • What is the Members List Recent Activity Feature?
  • How does the Feature Work?
    • Viewing Activity Cards
    • Engaging with Activity Cards
    • Types of Activity Content
    • Activity Privacy
  • Have Ideas or Feedback?

What is the Members List Recent Activity Feature?

This feature is currently in beta. It is limited to a small percentage of users within English-prominent regions and available only on the desktop app. This being the case, the experiment is subject to change or may be removed.

Want to easily catch up with your friends and create more shared experiences together?

With the Members List Recent Activity feature, you’ll be able to view the recent activities of your friends and recent contacts - including the video games they’re playing, the music they’re listening to, and much more!

How does the Feature Work?

Viewing Activity Cards

With the Members List Recent Activity feature, you’ll be able to view activity cards within Discord. Activity cards will show live and recent activities of those you’ve interacted with - within servers and your friends. 

If an activity is currently taking place, it’ll show an incrementing timer for how much time has elapsed. Otherwise, it’ll show how long ago the activity took place. 

You can collapse the view down to three activity cards and expand to see everything (up to 50 recent activities).

You can also choose to fully collapse activity cards or hide activity cards by selecting the cogwheel [] (within the activity card) and pressing the checkbox for the Hide Activity Cards option. 

Engaging with Activity Cards

Want to ask a friend about that new game they’re playing? By selecting the activity cards, you can reply directly to the activity or even send them an emoji. In either case, this will send a direct message (DM) with a reference to the activity.

 

Types of Activity Content

Initially, the content shown within activity cards will reflect gaming activity, but over time, other types of activity will also be shown - including game achievements, Spotify, Crunchyroll, and more.

Activity Privacy

If you want to prevent your activity from showing up in this feature, you can do so in two ways: 1) globally or 2) for a specific game.

Globally

If you want to control whether any activity is shared, you can enable or disable your global settings in the Activity Privacy settings. 

1. Head over to your User Settings by selecting the cogwheel [] in the bottom left corner.

2. Then under the Activity Settings section, select Activity Privacy. 

3. From here, you can use the toggle to enable or disable Share Activity with Others.

Specific Games

Alternatively, if you just want to prevent a specific game from being shared, you can disable specific games through the Registered Games menu. 

1. Head over to your User Settings by selecting the cogwheel [] in the bottom left corner.

2. Then under the Activity Settings section, select Registered Games.

3. From here, you can select the icon for Toggle Detection to prevent a game from showing up in the activity cards going forward.

Have Ideas or Feedback? 

Let us know via this link! We’re especially curious to hear what other types of activities you and your friend groups would have fun talking about together!

name: Data Used to Personalize Discord
title: Data Used to Personalize Discord
body:
Personalization 

We use certain information to personalize our services. This includes features like customizing your experience on our discovery surfaces, highlighting activity on Discord that may interest you, and surfacing Discord features and promotions from us and our partners that may be of interest to you. For example, we may use information about who you interact with to rank a Friend who you interact with often higher in the “Active Now” section of your Friends List.

The information used to power personalized features for you include: 

  • The games you play
  • Who you interact with
  • The way you use Discord
  • Connections made between your Discord account and another service (e.g., Xbox or Steam)
  • The servers you are in

Turning the Use Data to Personalize my Discord setting off means we will no longer use information specific to your account to power features that recommend content or promotions to you. 

Your ability to access conversations, voice channels, or other spaces on Discord will not be impacted by this setting.

name: Data Used to Improve Discord
title: Data Used to Improve Discord
body:
We use certain information to help us understand and improve Discord and to develop features that make Discord safer and better for you to use. This includes information such as how you use our services, the games you play, and how servers are structured. 

Turning the Use Data to Improve Discord Setting off means we will no longer collect new information about how you use and/or navigate Discord in order to understand and improve our products. We may continue to use the information we collected when the setting was enabled. More detail can be found in our Privacy Policy. 

It will also prevent us from automatically improving the quality of voice or video communications on Discord based on your usage.

If you’d like to further assert your right to object to our processing of your data, email privacy@discord.com.

When you turn the setting off, the signals associated with your use of Discord continue to be sent, but we do not use the information for the purposes described above. This is an account-based setting and applies to your use of Discord regardless of the device used to access your account. This allows us to keep your account experience consistent across devices and access points of Discord.

name: 1 Month Discord Nitro for Alienware Arena Members - 2024 Promo FAQ
title: 1 Month Discord Nitro for Alienware Arena Members - 2024 Promo FAQ
body:
Starting from February 28, 2024 (10AM PST) to May 28, 2024 (11:59PM PST), Alienware Arena members can claim 1 month of free Discord Nitro. Learn below about how you can claim Discord Nitro.

Promotion Summary

Offer Details: 1 month of free Discord Nitro

Who is Eligible: Users who have had an active Nitro membership or Nitro trial in the last 12 months are not eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Users who have had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on their accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If a user has had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on their account and they’ve never had a Nitro membership, redeeming this promotion will override that membership.

We will not be able to refund any leftover membership time from those, and the user will be forfeiting the remainder of the existing membership when activating the 1 month Nitro trial.

Users who have already claimed a gift from this promotion are not eligible to claim further gifts from this promotion.

This promotion is only available in certain regions. If you receive an "Unknown Gift Code" error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Requirements: Claim through Alienware Arena account by May 28, 2024 (11:59PM PST), and redeem in your Discord account by June 27, 2024 (11:59PM PST).

Membership: After the 1 month free trial period, your Nitro membership will convert to a monthly recurring membership, and Discord will bill your payment method for per month until you cancel it. You can cancel at any time in your Discord User Settings. 

What does this article cover?

  • What is Discord Nitro?
  • What is Alienware Arena?
  • How do I claim the Nitro Promo from my Alienware Arena account?  
  • How do I redeem the Nitro Trial on my Discord Account? 
    • Eligibility for Redeeming the Nitro Trial
      • What if I am an Active Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting Member? 
  • How do I share my code with a Friend? 
  • Frequently Asked Questions
    • Promotion Details
    • Eligibility for the Promotion
    • Payment Info and Membership Questions
    • Potential Errors and Other Issues

What is Discord Nitro?

Discord Nitro is our subscription plan that gives you access to special perks that’ll make your time on Discord as fun as ever! Personalize and enhance your experience with popular perks like HD streaming, 500MB file uploads, profile and avatar customizations, 2 free Server Boosts, and more:

  • Custom Emojis
  • Discord App Color Themes
  • Super Reactions
  • Avatar Decorations
  • Unique Server Profiles
  • Server Boosts
  • More Nitro & Nitro Basic perks

What is Alienware Arena?

Alienware Arena is a place for gamers to come together and build community while earning Arena Rewards Points (ARP) along the way. Users can earn ARP on their own just by gaming and completing daily tasks, or engage with each other by chatting in the forums, reading about gaming news in the blog, and participating in Community Challenges together. Learn more here.

How do I claim the Nitro Promo from Alienware Arena account?

To claim this Discord Nitro gift from your Alienware Arena account, make sure to log into the Alienware Arena site and keep an eye out for notifications from Alienware! You can also check out the Alienware Arena page here for more details.

How do I redeem the Nitro Trial on my Discord Account?

- Before redeeming Nitro, make sure you are logged in your own Discord account.
- If you accidentally redeemed the Nitro promo on an account that is not yours, we are unable to provide you with another promo.

Once you have claimed the promo, you'll now need to officially redeem this promo on your Discord account. You must redeem this Nitro trial by May 28, 2024 (11:59PM PST). Here’s how to redeem the code:

1. Head to your User Settings by tapping on the cog wheel.

2. Next, tap on the Gift Inventory tab and you’ll see the option to enter the Nitro Trial code.

3. After pasting in the code, tap on Redeem to redeem the Nitro Trial.

4. You should then receive a confirmation that the code has been redeemed.

After accepting the promo to your account, you'll now be automatically redirected to your Subscriptions tab in your User Settings to see your newly activated Nitro membership on your account.

Eligibility for Redeeming the Nitro Trial

This promotion is only available in certain regions. If you receive an "Unknown Gift Code" error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Users who have had an active Nitro membership or Nitro trial in the last 12 months are not eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Users who have had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on their accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If a user has had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on their account and they’ve never had a Nitro membership, redeeming this promotion will override that membership.

Users who have already claimed a gift from this promotion are not eligible to claim further gifts from this promotion.

What if I am an Active Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting Member? 

Just to clarify - if you have had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on your account and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

So long as you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro membership, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro membership.

HOWEVER, please note: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current memberships, and **you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current membership**.

At the end of the promotion period, you'll be converted to a paying Nitro membership per month unless you cancel your membership.

How do I share my Code with a Friend?

If you're unable to redeem the Nitro Trial code, you can share the gift code with a friend to use instead.

After you press on and copy the promotion code, you can directly copy and share the promotion code with your friend. We recommend sending the Nitro gift in a private direct message. Make sure your friend redeems the code by June 27, 2024 [11:59PM PST].

Frequently Asked Questions

We know there's a lot of information to unpack on this promotion above, so we've also broken down this information in this FAQ section as well too.

  • Promotion Details
  • Eligibility for the Promotion
  • Payment Info and Membership Questions
  • Potential Errors and Other Issues
    • Already Had/Have Nitro
    • Already Redeemed
    • Something's Wrong Here

Promotion Details

Q: How long does this promotion run for?

A: Alienware Arena Members can claim Discord Nitro promo between February 28, 2024 (10AM PST) to May 28, 2024 (11:59PM PST).

After May 28, 2024 (11:59PM PST), Alienwear Arena Members will no longer be able to claim a trial promo.

Q: How long does the Discord Nitro promotion last for?

A: You must redeem the Nitro promotion by June 27, 2024 (11:59PM PST).

If a code has not been redeemed to the Discord account by May 28, 2024 (11:59PM PST), it will expire and you will no longer be able to have 1 month of Discord Nitro.

Eligibility for the Promotion

Q: Who can claim this promotion from their Alienware Arena Members account?

A: [need to follow up with partner for claim flow]

Q: Who can redeem this Nitro trial to their Discord account?

A: Users who have never had an active Nitro membership on their Discord accounts are eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Additionally, users who previously had a Discord Nitro membership and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months are ineligible.

This promotion is only available in certain regions. If you receive an "Unknown Gift Code" error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Q: What if I'm a current or previous Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or a Server Boost membership? Can I also take part in this promotion? 

A: If you previously had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on your accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro membership,  you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro membership.

HOWEVER, please note: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current memberships, and **you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current membership**.

At the end of the promotion period, you'll be converted to a paying Nitro membership per month unless you cancel your membership.

Payment Info and Membership Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?

A: Because Nitro is a membership plan, at the end of your free 1 month trial, we will start your first billing cycle so you can continue to enjoy Nitro on Discord.

However, you can cancel the Nitro membership at any time before the end of the 1 month.

Q: Why do I see a temporary hold/charge on my account when this is supposed to be a free promotion?

A: Just to clarify, this Nitro promotion is free, however, there will be a temporary hold placed on the payment method upon activating the promotion. This is to help Discord confirm the payment method works as expected and to prevent the use of fraudulent payment methods. This charge will appear in your Discord transaction history, and it may appear as a hold on your payment method.

We immediately reverse the temporary hold, and you’ll see that reflected in your Discord transaction history. Your bank may take longer to remove the hold from your payment method.

Note: Banks will usually remove the temporary hold from your account within a few business days.

If your Discord transaction history does not show the hold released after 5 business days, please let us know at https://dis.gd/contact, and our support team will be able to investigate this issue further.

Potential Errors and Other Issues

Q: I see a Sad Trombone error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo code.

A: You might be inputting your Nitro incorrectly in the Gift Inventory. When trying to redeem your code, enter only your unique 24-digit code from the Nitro promotion in the following format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX

Q: I see a "Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already" error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you're seeing an "Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already" error, that means that the Discord account you're trying to redeem this promotion on currently has a Nitro membership so it is ineligible for this Nitro promotion.

Please make sure you're logged into the account that you want to redeem this promotion on. Or you can give the promotion gift to a friend who hasn't had Nitro before.

Q: I see a "Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub!" error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you're seeing an “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub” error, that means that you've previously subscribed to Nitro on your Discord account and you won't be able to redeem this 1 month perk. However, this promotion gift can be gifted to a friend.

If you have never subscribed to Nitro, please submit a ticket through our support system: https://dis.gd/contact and our support team will be able to investigate further.

Be sure to include your full Discord ID and email address tied to your Discord account

Q: I see a "This gift has already been claimed" error when I try to claim my Nitro promo.

A: If you are seeing a "This gift has been claimed already" error, that means that the Nitro promo has already been used and cannot be used again. You may need to double check if you've claimed this promo on another Discord account.

Unfortunately, once the promo has been claimed, the promo cannot be re-enabled, and the Nitro cannot be transferred from one account to another.

Q: I see a "Wait a Second...Looks like this code didn't work." error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you're seeing an “Wait a Second...Looks like this code didn't work.” error, that means that the promo is invalid.

If you received this promotion gift from a friend, double check with your friend on the exact Nitro gift code to make sure that it matches the code they claimed.

Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if your friend has given an invalid Nitro gift code and we will not be able to provide a new gift.

Q: I see a “Looks like something went wrong” error when I click on “Next”.

A: There are several reasons why you may be seeing this error:

  • You are ineligible for this promotion
  • The promotion is invalid
  • The promotion has reached the maximum number of claims
  • The gift code is invalid

Please note that the Discord support team is not able to assist if you run into this error when attempting to redeem. See the list above for possible reasons why your account may be ineligible or otherwise unable to redeem this promotion.

Q: I see a "Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption" error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you're seeing a "Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption" error, that means that the payment method you've selected to cover the temporary $1 hold cannot be used for that purpose. 

Please keep in mind that prepaid payment methods, such as Gcash, cannot be used to cover temporary holds due to the nature of how prepaid payment methods function.

For more information on temporary holds, please check out this article!

Q: I see a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error, that means the maximum limit for claims of this promotion has been reached and this promotion can no longer be claimed. If you have claimed this Nitro promotion, you are still able to redeem it to your Discord account!

Please note that the support team is unable to assist you if you run into this error and we are not able to increase the limit of claims.

Q: I see a “Looks like your email isn’t verified. Make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift.”

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like your email isn’t verified, make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift” error, you are trying to redeem this Nitro promotion on a Discord account with an email that hasn’t been verified yet.

You can check out this support article on how to resend the email verification for your Discord account. If you need help setting up your Discord account, you can read our Getting Started article. 

Q: I’m having trouble with my Alienware Arena Members account.

A: Reach out to Alienware Arena Members’s support team: contact@alienwarearena.com

name: Using Apps on Discord
title: Using Apps on Discord
body:
What does this article covers: 

  • What are Apps? 
  • How to Use Apps
    • Launching Apps with the Shapes Button 
    • Slash Commands
    • User and Message Commands
  • How to Discover Apps
  • How to Add Apps
    • Within the App Directory
    • From the App’s Profile
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What Are Apps?

Discord Apps add functionality, entertainment, and productivity tools to your servers, direct messages (DMs), group chats, and voice calls. These apps can range from bots that automate tasks, to activities that allow you to play games, collaborate on projects, or share experiences with others directly within Discord. 

Apps are created by Discord, third parties, or by Discord users and can vary from games to moderation to everything else in between. If you’re an app developer and would like to learn more about apps on Discord, you can check out our Developer Support Help Center.

Types of Discord Apps:

1. Bots: Automated programs that can perform a variety of tasks such as moderating chats, providing user support, playing music, or organizing games. They typically exist within a server and appear as a member of the server.

2. Activities: Interactive experiences like games, quizzes, or collaborative tools such as whiteboards that you can enjoy with others in real-time in text chats or voice calls. Learn more about activities in our Activities on Discord Help Center article.

How to Use Apps

You can interact with an app in a multitude of ways. If you have an app installed, you can use one of its commands by using slash commands, or by right-clicking on a user or message and selecting Apps.

Launching Apps with the Shapes Button

The Shapes button is currently only available in servers on mobile.

The easiest way to launch an app is by selecting the Shapes button in the chat bar and selecting the app you would like to start. 

 

It then provides an interface for selecting preset commands for the app without having to type them out.

   

Slash Commands

To use an app’s slash commands via the chat bar, simply type ”/” in chat to bring up the command picker and select the command you would like to use. You can also type the entire “/ (command)” within the text box to initiate the command.

For more information on slash commands, check out this article.

User and Message Commands

You can also interact with an app by right-clicking on a user or message and bringing up the dropdown menu. Additional interactions can be found under the Apps sub-menu.

Note: Every app is different. To learn how each app functions, check out the app’s member profile or the App Directory page for the app. 

How to Discover Apps

Discord’s App Directory lets you search, browse, and explore various apps you can add to customize your server. 

Note: The App Directory is only available on desktop and browser. 

To find various apps available on Discord, you can head over to the App Directory.

1. Head over to your server and left-click the server name located in the upper-left corner. 

2. Then, select Server Settings > App Directory. 

You can learn more about the App Directory here. 

How to Add Apps

Once you’ve had a chance to explore the App Directory and browse the various categories, you may find an app you would like to add.

Most apps can be added to a server where you have the Manage Server permission, or where you’re the owner of the server. 

Alternatively, some apps can be added directly to your account. Apps that can be added to your account will ask if you want to add the app to your account instead of to a server.

Within the App Directory

1. If you meet the permission requirements, head over to the App Directory and select an app you would like to add. While in the app’s page, you can read the Overview to learn more about the app and its functionality. 

2. Then, press Add App and follow the prompts to confirm you would like to add the app. Some apps may ask if you want to add the app to your account or server, you can choose where to add the app here.

Adding user apps from the App Directory is currently an experiment and slowly rolling out to users. 

4. Then, you can follow the prompts which will show you what permissions and access the app will require.

5. Once you select Authorize and complete the prompts, you will receive a confirmation. 

If you added the app to your server, it will appear in your server’s Member List and in your Server Settings > Integrations > Bots and Apps. If you added the app to your account, you will see it under your settings, under Authorized Apps.

From the App’s Profile

You can also add an app by viewing the app’s profile. 

1. While in a server, select the app to view its profile.

2. Then, press Add App and follow the prompts. 

4. Next, some apps may ask if you want to add the app to your account or server, you can choose where to add the app here.

5. Once you’re ready, complete the prompts and select Authorize to confirm you would like to add the app to your account or server.    

5. If you added the app to your server, it will appear in your server’s Member List. If you added the app to your account, you will see it under your User Settings > Authorized Apps. 

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Who should I reach out to if I am experiencing issues with the app?

A: Discord does not create or maintain apps, app developers do themselves. 

If you are experiencing issues with the app, please reach out to the app’s support team by heading over to their app’s support server. Most support servers can be found within the app’s Overview section within the App Directory. 

Q: Who is able to manage apps in a server?

A: To manage apps in a server, you must be the owner of the server or have the Manage Server permissions enabled. 

Q: I no longer want the app in my server. How do I remove the app? 

A: To remove the app, right-click the app’s bot within the Members list and kick the bot. By kicking the bot from the server, the app will be removed. 

Q: Where can I use Apps?

A: Currently, most apps are only available for use in servers if someone with permissions has added them for members to use. We want it to be easier for users to access apps, so we're experimenting with a way for users to add apps to their own account to use in spaces they're in across Discord.

Q: How do I install an app to my account?

A: Some apps can be installed to your account directly, instead of a server. Some developers will be updating their apps to enable this functionality. If you see an app that has this feature enabled, feel free to add the app to your account! Please note that apps that are added to your account may not have all the same capabilities as apps added to a server. During this testing phase in servers with more than 25 members, only you will be able to see an app's response to your application command.

Q: Do user installed apps have access to data about my server or DM, or the people in it?

A: No, these apps installed to your account are not able to access information about your server or DMs. They also do not have permissions to take action in your server or DMs, other than responding to your interactions. Additionally,  user installed apps are not able to get information about members of your servers or DMs that have not used the app. If a user does choose to interact with the app (e.g., through buttons and select menus), then the app can access their basic user information, like their username and guild member information (if in a server). 

Please refer to the app’s developer or its privacy policy to learn more about its data practices. You can also learn more about data access by apps installed in servers generally here.

name: 1 Month of Nitro for Monster Hunter Now Players
title: 1 Month of Nitro for Monster Hunter Now Players
body:
Starting from March 19, 2024 (10:00am PST) to April 18, 2024 (11:59pm PST), Monster Hunter Now players can claim 1 month of Discord Nitro. Learn below about how you can claim Discord Nitro.

Promotion Summary

Offer Details: 1 month of Discord Nitro

Who is Eligible: Users who have had an active Nitro membership or Nitro trial in the last 12 months are not eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Users who have had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on their accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If a user has had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on their account and they’ve never had a Nitro membership, redeeming this promotion will override that membership.

We will not be able to refund any leftover membership time from those, and the user will be forfeiting the remainder of the existing membership when activating the 1 month Nitro trial.

Users who have already claimed a gift from this promotion are not eligible to claim further gifts from this promotion.

This promotion is only available in certain regions. If you receive an "Unknown Gift Code" error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Requirements: Claim through the Monster Hunter Now mobile app from March 19, 2024 (10:00am PST) to April 18, 2024 (11:59pm PST), and redeem in your Discord account by April 25, 2024 (11:59pm PST).

Membership: After the 1 month trial period, your Nitro membership will convert to a monthly recurring membership, and Discord will bill your payment method for per month until you cancel it. You can cancel at any time in your Discord User Settings. 

What this article covers: 

  • What is Discord Nitro?
  • What is Monster Hunter Now?
  • How do I claim the Nitro Promo from my Monster Hunter Now account?  
  • How do I redeem the Nitro Trial on my Discord Account? 
    • Eligibility for Redeeming the Nitro Trial
    • Step by Step Redeem Instructions
      • What if I am an Active Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting Member? 
  • Frequently Asked Questions
    • Promotion Details
    • Eligibility for the Promotion
    • Payment Info and Membership Questions
    • Potential Errors and Other Issues

What is Discord Nitro?

Discord Nitro is our membership plan that gives you access to special perks that’ll make your time on Discord as fun as ever! Personalize and enhance your experience with popular perks like HD streaming, 500MB file uploads, profile and avatar customizations, 2 free Server Boosts, and more:

  • Custom Emojis
  • Discord App Color Themes
  • Super Reactions
  • Avatar Decorations
  • Unique Server Profiles
  • Server Boosts
  • More Nitro & Nitro Basic perks

What is Monster Hunter Now?

Monster Hunter Now is a location-based action RPG mobile game where you team up with other players to hunt monsters in the real world. The core loop is simple – explore your neighborhood to hunt monsters, battle, craft weapons & armor, repeat.

So, get out and hunt together!

How do I claim the Nitro Promo from my Monster Hunter Now account?

1. To get started, open up the mobile Monster Hunter Now app and register a new account. 

2. If you already have an existing account or have completed the account creation, be sure to subscribe to email notifications by navigating to the Hunter Menu > Settings > enable Email Me Events, Offers, and Updates. 

3. Once subscribed, you will receive the Nitro promotion details within your email notification. 

Please be sure to check your email inbox to claim your Nitro promotion. If you do not see the email, please allow up to 48 hours for the Nitro promotion email to arrive after registering your Monster Hunter Now account. If it's not in your inbox, remember to check back later.

How do I redeem the Nitro Trial on my Discord Account?

Once you have claimed the promo, you'll now need to officially redeem this promo on your Discord account. You must redeem this Nitro trial by April 25, 2024 (11:59pm PST).

Eligibility for Redeeming the Nitro Trial

This promotion is only available in certain regions. If you receive an "Unknown Gift Code" error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Users who have had an active Nitro membership or Nitro trial in the last 12 months are not eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Users who have had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on their accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If a user has had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on their account and they’ve never had a Nitro membership, redeeming this promotion will override that membership.

Users who have already claimed a gift from this promotion are not eligible to claim further gifts from this promotion.

Step by Step Redeem Instructions

If you're eligible and ready to redeem this Nitro membership on your own Discord account, you can follow these steps below to redeem the promo.

NOTE:
- Before redeeming Nitro, make sure you are logged in your own Discord account.
- If you accidentally redeemed the Nitro promo on an account that is not yours, we are unable to provide you with another promo.

Step 1 - Pressing the Promo Link/Copy and Pasting the Promo Link into your Browser Window

In the email with the Nitro promotion details, there is a promotional URL link that you can press or copy and paste into your browser search bar to begin the redemption process.

Note: If you enter this Nitro promotion link into the Discord Gift Inventory, you will see an error when attempting to redeem the promotion. This is the incorrect method of redeeming this promo.

Step 2 - Logging into Discord

If you're not already logged into Discord in your browser, you will then be automatically redirected to either:

Register for a New Account

If you don't have an account, you can directly register a new Discord account

Login to your Account

If you already have a Discord account, you can login to your account using your email and password or using QR code login

Step 3 - Redeeming your promotion gift

Once you have logged into your Discord account, you'll see a new message asking you to confirm that you are accepting the Nitro membership on the correct Discord account. Review the details of the promotion then press on Next. 

Note: If you're logged into the incorrect Discord account, press the "Wrong account" button to login to the other account!

 

Make sure your payment information is accurate. If your Discord account does not have your payment information, please fill out your payment details. You will not be charged until the free trial ends and the membership renews.

When you've filled out all the necessary information and you're ready to redeem this promotion, press the confirmation button.

Step 4 - Membership Now Activated

After accepting the promo to your account, you'll now be automatically redirected to your Subscriptions tab in your User Settings to see your newly activated Nitro membership on your account.

What if I am an Active Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting Member? 

Just to clarify - if you have had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on your account and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

So long as you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro membership, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro membership.

HOWEVER, please note: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current memberships, and **you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current membership**.

At the end of the promotion period, you'll be converted to a paying Nitro membership per month unless you cancel your membership.

How do I share my Code with a Friend?

If you've had a Nitro membership previously on your Discord account in the past 12 months and you're unable to redeem the Nitro promotion link, you can share this link with a friend to use instead.

After you locate the promotion email, you can copy the promotion link and send it to a friend. We recommend sending the link in a private direct message.

Frequently Asked Questions

We know there's a lot of information to unpack on this promotion above, so we've also broken down this information in this FAQ section as well too.

  • Promotion Details
  • Eligibility for the Promotion
  • Payment Info and Membership Questions
  • Potential Errors and Other Issues
    • Already Had/Have Nitro
    • Already Redeemed
    • Something's Wrong Here

Promotion Details

Q: How long does this promotion run for?

A: Monster Hunter Now players can claim Discord Nitro promo between March 19, 2024 (10:00am PST) to April 18, 2024 (11:59pm PST).

After  April 18, 2024 (11:59pm PST), Monster Hunter Now players will no longer be able to claim a trial promo.

Q: How long does the Discord Nitro promotion last for?

A: You must redeem the Nitro promotion by April 25, 2024 (11:59pm PST).

If a code has not been redeemed to the Discord account by April 25, 2024 (11:59pm PST), it will expire and you will no longer be able to have 1 month of Discord Nitro.

Eligibility for the Promotion

Q: Who can claim this promotion from their Monster Hunter Now account?

A: New and existing Monster Hunter Now players will be able to receive this promotion.

To get started: 

1. Open up the Monster Hunter Now app and register a new account. 

2. If you already have an existing registered account or have completed the account registration, be sure to subscribe to email notifications. 

3. Once subscribed, you will receive the Nitro promotion details within your email notification. 

Q: Who can redeem this Nitro trial to their Discord account?

A: Users who have never had an active Nitro membership on their Discord accounts are eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Additionally, users who previously had a Discord Nitro membership and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months are ineligible.

This promotion is only available in certain regions. If you receive an "Unknown Gift Code" error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Q: What if I'm a current or previous Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or a Server Boost membership? Can I also take part in this promotion? 

A: If you previously had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on your accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro membership,  you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro membership.

HOWEVER, please note: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current memberships, and **you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current membership**.

At the end of the promotion period, you'll be converted to a paying Nitro membership per month unless you cancel your membership.

Payment Info and Membership Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?

A: Because Nitro is a membership plan, at the end of your 1 month trial, we will start your first billing cycle so you can continue to enjoy Nitro on Discord.

However, you can cancel the Nitro membership at any time before the end of the 1 month.

Q: Why do I see a temporary hold/charge on my account when this is supposed to be a free promotion?

A: Just to clarify, this Nitro promotion is free, however, there will be a temporary hold placed on the payment method upon activating the promotion. This is to help Discord confirm the payment method works as expected and to prevent the use of fraudulent payment methods. This charge will appear in your Discord transaction history, and it may appear as a hold on your payment method.

We immediately reverse the temporary hold, and you’ll see that reflected in your Discord transaction history. Your bank may take longer to remove the hold from your payment method.

Note: Banks will usually remove the temporary hold from your account within a few business days.

If your Discord transaction history does not show the hold released after 5 business days, please let us know at https://dis.gd/contact, and our support team will be able to investigate this issue further.

Potential Errors and Other Issues

Q: I see a "Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already" error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you're seeing an "Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already" error, that means that the Discord account you're trying to redeem this promotion on currently has a Nitro membership so it is ineligible for this Nitro promotion.

Please make sure you're logged into the account that you want to redeem this promotion on. Or you can give the promotion link to a friend who hasn't had Nitro before!

Q: I see a "Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub!" error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you're seeing an “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub” error, that means that you've previously subscribed to Nitro on your Discord account and you won't be able to redeem this 1 month perk. However, this promo link can be gifted to a friend!

If you have never subscribed to Nitro, please submit a ticket through our support system: https://dis.gd/contact and our support team will be able to investigate further.

Be sure to include your full Discord ID and email address tied to your Discord account.

Q: I see a "This gift has already been claimed" error when I try to claim my Nitro promo.

A: If you are seeing a "This gift has been claimed already" error, that means that the Nitro promo has already been used and cannot be used again. You may need to double check if you've claimed this promo on another Discord account.

Unfortunately, once the promo has been claimed, the promo cannot be re-enabled, and the Nitro cannot be transferred from one account to another.

Q: I see a "Wait a Second...Looks like this code didn't work." error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you're seeing an “Wait a Second...Looks like this code didn't work.” error, that means that the promo is invalid.

If you received this link from a friend, double check with your friend on the exact link to make sure that it matches the link in the email with the promotion link!Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if you are given an invalid promo and we will not be able to provide a new promo.

Q: I see a “Looks like something went wrong” error when I click on “Next”.

A: There are several reasons why you may be seeing this error:

  • You are ineligible for this promotion
  • The promotion is invalid
  • The promotion has reached the maximum number of claims
  • The link is invalid

Please note that the Discord support team is not able to assist if you run into this error when attempting to redeem. See the list above for possible reasons why your account may be ineligible or otherwise unable to redeem this promotion.

Q: I see a "Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption" error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you're seeing a "Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption" error, that means that the payment method you've selected to cover the temporary $1 hold cannot be used for that purpose. 

Please keep in mind that prepaid payment methods, such as Gcash, cannot be used to cover temporary holds due to the nature of how prepaid payment methods function.

For more information on temporary holds, please check out this article!

Q: I see a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error, that means the maximum limit for claims of this promotion has been reached and this promotion can no longer be claimed. If you have claimed this Nitro promotion, you are still able to redeem it to your Discord account!

Please note that the support team is unable to assist you if you run into this error and we are not able to increase the limit of claims.

Q: I see a “Looks like your email isn’t verified. Make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift.”

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like your email isn’t verified, make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift” error, you are trying to redeem this Nitro promotion on a Discord account with an email that hasn’t been verified yet.

You can check out this support article on how to resend the email verification for your Discord account. If you need help setting up your Discord account, you can read our Getting Started article. 

Q: I’m having trouble with my Monster Hunter Now account.

A: Reach out to Niantic’s Help Center for further assistance: https://niantic.helpshift.com/hc/en/39-monster-hunter-now/.
